description: This header file defines template classes and functions for managing 3D tables and 2D tables used in a firmware project, including interpolation, initialization, and data setting functionalities. It appears to be part of an engine control or similar automotive firmware project.

classes.name: Map3D
classes.description: Template class representing a 3D map with two 2D axis curves, used for engine parameter mappings like AFR, ignition, etc.

classes.name: Table2D
classes.description: Template class representing a 2D table with pre-calculated interpolation coefficients.

methods.name: preCalc
methods.description: Pre-calculates interpolation coefficients for a 2D table.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a 3D map with data tables and axis bin arrays.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves interpolated value from a 3D map based on RPM and load.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Initializes the Map3D object with a name and optional multiplier.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets all data points in the Map3D to a specific value.

methods.name: copy2DTable
methods.description: Copies data from a source 2D table to a destination 2D table.

methods.name: Table2D
methods.description: Constructor for Table2D class, initializes internal bin pointer.

methods.name: preCalc
methods.description: Pre-calculates linear interpolation coefficients for the 2D table.

methods.name: setArrayValues
methods.description: Macro to set all values in an array to a specific value.

methods.name: setLinearCurve
methods.description: Defines a linear curve across an array.

methods.name: setRpmTableBin
methods.description: Initializes RPM bin array with a standard table.
